description: Lane PROG: a long turn never looks frozen. A slow multi-round web lookup keeps the chat alive (a typing keep-alive at every round boundary and ONE plain progress line), and a message that arrives while that turn runs is kept and answered after it, not lost.

persona.name: pa-prog-${name}
persona.directive: You help Priya with her shop's stock and delivery questions.

steps.say: Please use the web, one search at a time, to find today's UK prices for three things: a First Class stamp, a litre of milk, and a cinema ticket in London. Report each price in pounds on its own line.

steps.say: While you finish that, please remember permanently: my delivery van goes out at 7:40 on Fridays. Confirm when stored.
